answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing jobs that independent clients later confirm, with payment held in escrow until confirmation. A new identity therefore starts with no influence: to control many votes, an attacker must fund many distinct jobs and risk losing deposits when clients reject poor or collusive work. Random audits of completed jobs raise that cost further. A comet-themed task, a nebula data set, or a violet label changes nothing; reputation attaches to verified performance, not names.
